Braised Chicken Legs with Rice, Potatoes & Veggies🍗 Ingredients * 1 package chicken drumsticks (6–7 pieces) * 1-2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp salt * 1 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp garlic powder * 2 tsp onion powder * 2 tsp paprika * ½ tsp cumin * 1 jalapeño, diced * ½ red onion, diced * 1 tbsp sun-dried tomato paste * 1 tbsp @Loisa sofrito * 5–6 garlic cloves, minced * 4 cups chicken stock * 1 (8 oz) can tomato sauce * Small potatoes, halved (about 10–12 baby potatoes) * 1 zucchini, diced * Cooked white rice, for serving (let me know if you guys want my rice recipe) Instructions: 1. Clean the chicken with vinegar, then pat completely dry with paper towels. 2. Season the chicken with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and cumin. Toss until evenly coated. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven or deep skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Brown the chicken for 2–3 minutes per side until golden. It doesn’t need to be cooked through. Remove and set aside. 5. In the same pot, add the diced jalapeño and red onion. Cook for about 5 minutes until softened. 6. Stir in the sun-dried tomato paste and cook for 30 seconds. 7. Add the Loisa Sofrito and minced garlic. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant. 8. Pour in the chicken stock and tomato sauce, stirring to combine. Bring to a gentle boil. 9. Return the chicken to the pot. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 1 hour, or until the chicken is fall-apart tender and the sauce has reduced. 10. About 20 minutes before the chicken is done, add the halved potatoes and diced zucchini. Continue simmering until the potatoes are fork-tender and the zucchini is cooked. 11. Serve over fluffy white rice and spoon plenty of the sauce over the top. #chickenlegs #braised #onepotmeals #cookwithme

⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. When ready to eat, microwave the rice with a wet paper towel first to get it steamed, then add in your meat and microwave till warm, and finally add your salad to preserve the crunch and enjoy! 📩 Save this Soy Glazed Chicken recipe to make for later! #highprotein #lowcaloriemeals #mealprep #mealplan #healthyrecipe #weightlossmeals #asianfood #chicken

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Meals for Weight-loss:  Mexican Chicken Corn Salad Ingredients:  Chicken * Chicken breast, 800 g * Lime juice, 2 tbsp * Avocado oil, 1 tbsp * Chili powder, 2 tsp * Cumin, 1.5 tsp * Garlic powder, 1 tsp * Paprika, 1 tsp * Salt, 1 tsp * Black pepper, 0.5 tsp Veggies * Cotija cheese, 50 g * Red onion, 1 large, finely diced * Red bell pepper, 1 large, finely diced * Cilantro, 1 handful, chopped * Jalapeños, 3, finely diced * Canned corn, 2 cups total, drained and charred Sauce * Plain 0% Greek yogurt, 1 cup * Lime juice, from 0.5 lime * Hot sauce, 1 tbsp * Tajín, 1 tbsp * Water, 0.5 cup * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste Instructions 1. Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized cubes, then add it to a bowl with lime juice, avocado oil, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well and marinate for 15 to 30 minutes. 2. Heat a large pan on medium-high heat. Divide the rice, broccoli, and honey garlic chicken between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. 🍗 Crockpot Garlic Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes 🥔 This Crockpot Garlic Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes is the ultimate comfort food. Juicy chicken thighs and tender baby potatoes are slow-cooked in a rich garlic butter sauce, then finished with melted Parmesan and mozzarella for a creamy, irresistible dinner the whole family will love. Ingredients For the Chicken and Potatoes • 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into large pieces • 1½ lbs baby red or Yukon Gold potatoes, quartered • 1 small onion, chopped • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 tsp paprika • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp onion powder • ¾ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper For the Garlic Parmesan Sauce • 4 tbsp butter, melted • 5 cloves garlic, minced • ½ cup chicken broth • 1 tbsp Dijon mustard • 1 tsp dried parsley • ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese • 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese • 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Instructions 1. Lightly grease a 6-quart slow cooker with cooking spray or butter. 2. Add the quartered potatoes and chopped onion to the bottom of the slow cooker. 3. In a large bowl, toss the chicken with olive oil, paprika, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper until evenly coated. 4. Arrange the seasoned chicken over the potatoes. 5. In a separate bowl, whisk together the melted butter, garlic, chicken broth, Dijon mustard, and dried parsley. 6. Pour the garlic butter mixture evenly over the chicken and potatoes. 7. Cover and cook on **LOW** for 6–7 hours or **HIGH** for 3–4 hours, until the chicken is fully cooked and the potatoes are fork-tender. 8. During the last 15 minutes of cooking, sprinkle the Parmesan and mozzarella evenly over the top. 9. Cover again and cook until the cheese is melted and the sauce is rich and creamy. 10. Gently stir everything together so the chicken and potatoes are coated in the garlic Parmesan sauce. 11. Garnish with fresh parsley before serving. Serving Suggestions Serve with steamed broccoli, roasted asparagus, a crisp green salad, or warm garlic bread for a complete meal. Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Reheat gently in the microwave or on the stovetop until warmed through. Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 6 hours Total Time: 6 hours 15 minutes Servings: 6 Calories: Approximately 560 per serving #CrockpotRecipes #ChickenDinner #GarlicParmesan #SlowCooker #ComfortFood
